source: Whew, it’s much quieter this morning.
translation: 呼，今天早上安静多了。

source: I got up earlier than yesterday just in case something happened again.
translation: 我起得比昨天早，以防又发生什么事。

source: Lloyd and Darius were gone from our cabin already so I thought their work might’ve started for the day, but I guess not.
translation: Lloyd和Darius已经不在木屋，我还以为他们今天的工作开始了，看来并没有。

source: The specialists probably won’t arrive for a while too… Maybe I should go out for a morning patrol first…
translation: 专业人员大概也要过一阵子才会到……也许我该先出去进行晨间巡逻……

source: Hnghhh!!! *huff* *huff*
translation: 嗯啊啊！！！*喘气* *喘气*

source: Hold it for five more seconds.
translation: 再保持五秒。

source: Haaaa!
translation: 哈啊啊！

source: Great.
translation: 很好。

source: G-Good morning, Lloyd and Darius!
translation: 早、早上好，Lloyd、Darius！

source: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。

source: What are you guys up to…?
translation: 你们在做什么……？

source: I’m sipping hot cocoa.
translation: 我在喝热可可。

source: Oh, hey, Yoshinori. I’m just doing my daily morning yoga.
translation: 哦，嗨，Yoshinori。我只是在做每天早晨的瑜伽。

source: I always make sure to do plenty of stretching, especially if there’s gonna be a lot of physical labor during the day.
translation: 我总会充分拉伸，尤其是白天要进行大量体力劳动的时候。

source: I hope you don’t mind the incense though. It helps me relax and loosen up.
translation: 希望你不介意这些熏香。它能帮助我放松身心。

source: It’s alright! It smells good, actually!
translation: 没关系！其实闻起来很香！

source: There’s also a lot of studies that say yoga makes you happier, healthier, and more flexible!
translation: 还有很多研究表明，瑜伽能让人更快乐、更健康，身体也更柔韧！

source: He’s doing it to be taller.
translation: 他练瑜伽是为了长高。

source: Dar, I left that out for a reason, you know…
translation: Dar，我故意没提这点是有原因的……

source: Well, it’s nice you’re taking good care of your health! I usually chop wood in the morning to wake my muscles up!
translation: 这个嘛，认真照顾健康是件好事！我通常早上劈柴，让肌肉清醒过来！

source: You should join me sometime! If you’re stressed, I have cleansing crystals that could help too! You’ll be feeling rejuvenated in no time!
translation: 你以后应该和我一起练！如果压力很大，我还有能帮上忙的净化水晶！很快就能让你精神焕发！

source: S-Sure, I’ll let you know when I need it…!
translation: 好、好的，需要时我会告诉你……！

source: So, do you always wake up this early too?
translation: 所以，你平时也总是这么早起床吗？

source: During the summer term, yes! But, this time, I just wanted to be available in case anyone needs something.
translation: 夏季营期时是的！不过这次，我只是想随时待命，以防有人需要帮助。

source: Haha, you’re quite the role model, as always! Believe it or not, you’re one of the people I looked up to when it came to leadership.
translation: 哈哈，你还是一如既往地堪称榜样！信不信由你，在领导力方面，你是我仰慕的人之一。

source: Ah… R-Really?
translation: 啊……真、真的吗？

source: Yeah! You always had a way of getting everyone to work together while making sure they were having fun too!
translation: 是啊！你总有办法让所有人共同合作，同时确保大家玩得开心！

source: If only you knew how much of that I was able to apply in my job as an architect.
translation: 你都不知道，我在建筑师的工作中运用了多少从你那里学到的东西。

source: I can imagine. You must be used to working with a lot of people to get a project done.
translation: 我能想象。为了完成项目，你一定习惯了与很多人合作。

source: Yeah! In a sense, it’s like your job as a scoutmaster!
translation: 没错！从某种意义上说，就像你的童军团长工作！

source: And now, you’re kinda dealing with something even more than that – having to oversee not only my team, but the other incoming specialists too.
translation: 而现在，你面对的事情甚至超出了这一范围——不仅要监督我的团队，还要负责其他即将到来的专业人员。

source: Uh… I’m sorry to interrupt you two, but…
translation: 呃……抱歉打断你们，不过……

source: There’s a guy who’s been walking around the entrance for a while now.
translation: 有个人已经在入口附近走来走去一阵子了。

source: Wh-What?
translation: 什、什么？

source: *pant* *pant*
translation: *喘气* *喘气*

source: Oh no, where is everybody…?
translation: 糟了，大家都在哪里……？

source: He’s not one of your staff, is he?
translation: 他不是你们的员工，对吧？

source: N-No, I don’t recognize him at all.
translation: 不、不是，我完全不认识他。

source: I think he’s lost.
translation: 我觉得他迷路了。

source: Let me go and talk to him!
translation: 我去和他谈谈！

source: Good morning! I’m Yoshinori Nagira, a scoutmaster here at Camp Buddy. How can I help you?
translation: 早上好！我是Yoshinori Nagira，Camp Buddy 的童军团长。有什么能帮您的吗？

source: O-Oh, thank goodness I’m in the right place!
translation: 哦、哦，谢天谢地，我来对地方了！

source: Please forgive my intrusion – 'I uhhh let myself into the property.
translation: 请原谅我擅自闯入——我、呃……自己走进了这片地方。

source: I am looking for a… Mr. Goro Nomoru? I have an appointment with him today…!
translation: 我在找一位……Goro Nomoru先生？今天和他有预约……！

source: Ah! I assume Clermont Inc. sent you?
translation: 啊！您是Clermont公司派来的吧？

source: Y-Yes, my name is Hyunjin Choi…!
translation: 是、是的，我叫Hyunjin Choi……！

source: I’m an IT specialist, and I’m here to perform an inspection and determine the camp’s technological needs.
translation: 我是一名IT专家，来这里进行检查，并评估营地的技术需求。

source: It’s a pleasure to meet you, uhh… Mr. Choi?
translation: 很高兴认识您，呃……Choi先生？

source: Please, just call me Jin!
translation: 请直接叫我 Jin！

source: Of course, and you can call me Yoshi!
translation: 当然，你也可以叫我Yoshi！

source: Here with me are Architect Sirius and Foreman Najjar! They were also sent by Clermont Inc. to work on this expansion project!
translation: 和我一起的是Sirius建筑师与Najjar工头！他们同样受Clermont公司派遣，负责这个扩建项目！

source: Hey, it’s nice to meet you, man! You can just call me Lloyd – looking forward to working with you!
translation: 嘿，很高兴认识你，伙计！直接叫我Lloyd就好——期待和你合作！

source: It’s a relief to know I’ll be working with someone around my age too, Lloyd!
translation: 知道自己也会和年龄相仿的人一起工作，我放心多了，Lloyd！

source: I’m a lot older than you think, but I get that a lot, haha!
translation: 我的年龄比你以为的大得多，不过经常有人这么说，哈哈！

source: I’m Darius. *shakes Hyunjin’s hand*
translation: 我是Darius。*与Hyunjin握手*

source: O-Oof… Y-You have really big hands, Darius… And a tight grip too…
translation: 哦、哦呜……你、你的手真大，Darius……握得也很紧……

source: I use them a lot.
translation: 我经常用它们干活。

source: A-Anyway…! I-I apologize if I’m late! I was up all night preparing for this…!
translation: 总、总之……！如果我迟到了，非、非常抱歉！我整晚都在为这件事作准备……！

source: Ah, you’re actually quite early – almost everyone else is still in their cabins, so please don’t worry about it!
translation: 啊，其实你来得很早——其他人几乎都还在木屋里，所以请别担心！

source: Yeah, man. It’s only, like, 6:00 AM! Chill!
translation: 是啊，伙计。现在才早上六点左右！放松！

source: I-I’m sorry…! It’s just, I was supposed to be here a day earlier, but I had to reschedule.
translation: 对、对不起……！只是我原本应该提前一天到，却不得不改期。

source: I-I’m not really used to working with a large group of people, so I’ve been preparing myself since this is a big job opportunity for me.
translation: 我、我不太习惯和一大群人合作，而且这是一次重要的工作机会，所以一直在让自己做好准备。

source: Oh, I get you! I never jump into the action without proper prep, or else it’d really hurt my ass!
translation: 哦，我懂你！没有充分准备，我从不会直接投入行动，否则屁股可要遭大罪！

source: That’s why I always make sure to have Dar here to help me, so things will go smoothly and be much more enjoyable!
translation: 所以我总会确保Dar在身边帮我，这样事情会进展顺利，也会愉快得多！

source: Yes.
translation: 是。

source: A-Ah, r-right…! In a project sense, of course…!
translation: 啊、啊，没、没错……！当然，是从项目的角度……！

source: Will you be staying here at camp for the span of this project too?
translation: 项目期间，你也会住在营地吗？

source: Yes…! I was informed that I need to stay and work here on-site to ensure maximum output since we have a tight schedule.
translation: 是的……！工期很紧，我接到的通知是需要留在这里现场工作，以确保最高效率。

source: Alright! I hope you don’t mind sharing the same quarters I’m in though. All the other cabins have been occupied by the construction workers.
translation: 好的！不过希望你不介意和我住同一间宿舍。其他木屋已经都被施工人员住满了。

source: O-Oh…! I… don’t mind that at all!
translation: 哦、哦……！我……完全不介意！

source: If that’s the case, shall we get you and your suitcases settled in? You must be tired from your trip.
translation: 既然这样，我们先帮你和行李安顿下来吧？一路过来一定累了。

source: A-Ah, that won’t be necessary for now!
translation: 啊、啊，暂时不用了！

source: I also don’t want to be late for my meeting with the camp president…!
translation: 而且我也不想错过和营地负责人的会议……！

source: Oh, of course! Let me bring you to his office!
translation: 哦，当然！我带你去他的办公室！

source: We’ll go ahead, you two! Sorry to cut our conversation short!
translation: 我们两个先走了！抱歉这么快就结束谈话！

source: It’s fine! We need to start working too! It was a pleasure meeting you, Jin!
translation: 没关系！我们也得开始工作了！很高兴认识你，Jin！

source: The pleasure’s all mine!
translation: 我才深感荣幸！

source: Right this way, Jin!
translation: 这边请，Jin！

source: Good morning, sir! Mr. Hyunjin Choi just arrived. He’s the IT specialist scheduled for a meeting with you today.
translation: 早上好，先生！Hyunjin Choi先生刚刚抵达。他是今天预约与您会面的IT专家。

source: Ah, yes. I’ve been expecting you, Mr. Choi. Please, take a seat.
translation: 啊，是的。我一直在等你，Choi先生。请坐。

source: I hope I’m not interrupting you by coming earlier than scheduled, Mr. Nomoru.
translation: Nomoru先生，希望我比约定时间早到没有打扰您。

source: It’s no problem. I’m just having my morning coffee.
translation: 没关系。我只是在喝早咖啡。

source: Is it alright with you if we address each other by our first names?
translation: 我们直接以名字互相称呼，可以吗？

source: O-Of course, sir! You can even call me Jin, for short!
translation: 当、当然可以，先生！您甚至可以简称我为 Jin！

source: Great. I want to make sure you’re comfortable during your stay here. Mr. Clermont told me quite a lot about you and your work.
translation: 很好。我想确保你在这里居住期间感到自在。Clermont先生向我介绍了很多关于你和你工作的事情。

source: O-Oh, really? He must be talking about the online bookstore I developed for his publishing company…!
translation: 哦、哦，真的吗？他说的一定是我为他的出版公司开发的线上书店……！

source: He did show me that in one of our meetings. Pretty impressive work.
translation: 他确实在一次会议上向我展示过。相当出色的作品。

source: Thank you, Sir Goro!
translation: 谢谢您，Goro先生！

source: I have to say, I'm pleasantly surprised meeting you today. When Mr. Clermont said he’d send an IT expert, I thought it would be someone who’s a lot older.
translation: 我得说，今天见到你让我感到惊喜。Clermont先生说会派来一名IT专家时，我还以为年纪会大得多。

source: I-I was thinking the same thing, sir…! You look so stylish for a camp president!
translation: 我、我也这么觉得，先生……！身为营地负责人，您看起来真有型！

source: Hahaha, spare me the compliments, Jin.
translation: 哈哈哈，别再恭维我了，Jin。

source: Wow… This is probably the first time a new guy hasn’t been intimidated meeting you, sir…
translation: 哇……先生，这大概是第一次有新人见到您时没有被吓到……

source: Apparently, it’s always better to be gentle with any first time.
translation: 看来无论什么第一次，温柔一点总会更好。

source: To give you a bit of history, Jin – as this camp’s president, I used to lead strictly, always charging in with an iron fist.
translation: Jin，给你讲讲过去吧——身为营地负责人，我以前管理得非常严格，做事总是雷厉风行。

source: *gulp*
translation: *咽口水*

source: But I gave my word to Yoshinori here that I’ll try to take things slowly and make people more relaxed with this approach.
translation: 不过我答应过这里的Yoshinori，会试着慢慢来，用这种方式让大家更加放松。

source: Haha, it seems like you’re working on your people-handling skills!
translation: 哈哈，看来您正在锻炼与人相处的技巧！

source: I’m doing just that with Jin here, and he seems to be very pleased.
translation: 我现在正对 Jin 这样做，而他看起来非常满意。

source: A-Ahh… W-Well, I really appreciate it, sir.
translation: 啊、啊……这、这个嘛，我真的非常感激，先生。

source: I hope you can use me… and my skills… for the camp!
translation: 希望您能充分使用我……以及我的技能……来帮助营地！

source: That is great to hear. Now, let’s get on to business.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。现在开始谈正事吧。

source: Jin, I have appointed Yoshinori here as your guide while you conduct an inspection of the camp.
translation: Jin，我已经指派这里的Yoshinori，在你检查营地期间担任向导。

source: You’ll be identifying what’s needed to implement all of the technological goals of the approved proposal.
translation: 你需要确定，为实现获批方案中的所有技术目标，需要配备哪些东西。

source: I understand that we’re quite far behind when it comes to adapting to the digital age, so we’re counting on your knowledge and recommendations to make the necessary improvements.
translation: 我知道我们在适应数字时代方面相当落后，所以要依靠你的知识和建议来完成必要改进。

source: Please also bear with us for being so outdated, even about the simplest of things. We’re hoping you can better educate us and help us adapt throughout this entire project.
translation: 我们甚至连最简单的事情都十分落伍，也请多包涵。希望在整个项目期间，你能更好地指导我们，帮助我们适应变化。

source: If it’s alright with you, I’d like to start here in your office!
translation: 如果您同意，我想从这间办公室开始！

source: Hmm… The only piece of technology we have here is our personal computer.
translation: 嗯……这里唯一的技术设备就是我们的个人电脑。

source: We know it’s fairly outdated… and it runs pretty slow, so we barely touch it most days.
translation: 我们知道它相当老旧……运行速度也很慢，所以平时几乎不会碰。

source: Whoa… This computer is at least a decade old…
translation: 哇……这台电脑至少有十年历史了……

source: I believe it’s even older than that, since I got it before the camp was even established…
translation: 我想它甚至更老，因为营地建立以前我就买了它……

source: Oh wow, so it’s basically a prehistoric relic…
translation: 哦，哇，那它基本就是史前遗物了……

source: Well, let’s give it a chance and take a closer look.
translation: 这个嘛，还是给它一个机会，仔细看看吧。

source: Hmm…
None of the fans are running – I’m shocked it even boots up at all…!
translation: 所有风扇都没在转——它居然还能开机，真让我震惊……！

source: It does take a while to turn on… We usually just go to the internet café nearby if we need something done digitally.
translation: 开机确实要花很久……如果需要处理数字事务，我们通常直接去附近的网吧。

source: One of our tech-savvy scouts last term actually went there to upload a promotional video for our fundraising campaign.
translation: 上个营期，一名精通技术的童军就去那里为筹款活动上传了宣传视频。

source: Yeah, I don’t think this one was even built to connect to the internet.
translation: 是啊，我觉得这台电脑在制造时甚至没考虑过连接互联网。

source: W-Well… We just thought we didn’t need it… since we’re an adventure-themed summer camp…
translation: 这、这个嘛……我们只觉得没有需要……毕竟这里是以冒险为主题的夏令营……

source: Gadgets are also banned from our daily activities…
translation: 日常活动中也禁止使用电子设备……

source: Wait, does that mean even the scoutmasters don’t carry phones around?
translation: 等等，这意味着连童军团长都不随身带手机吗？

source: Wait, does that mean even the scoutmasters don’t carry phones around?{fast}
translation: 等等，这意味着连童军团长都不随身带手机吗？{fast}

source: We should've allowed devices.
translation: 我们本该允许使用设备。

source: Yeah… Thinking about it, we probably should’ve allowed devices.
translation: 是啊……现在想想，我们或许应该允许使用设备。

source: It would’ve been much safer for the campers that way.
translation: 那样对营员来说会安全得多。

source: Hmph. It’s not as simple as it sounds, Yoshinori.
translation: 哼。事情没听起来那么简单，Yoshinori。

source: We can’t efficiently educate the campers on survival skills with technology to distract them.
translation: 如果科技产品让营员分心，我们就无法有效教授生存技能。

source: It also goes against the spirit of the camp, especially the social aspect of it.
translation: 这也违背营地精神，尤其是其中强调社交的部分。

source: I'm not sure why we don't.
translation: 我不确定为什么不允许。

source: Yeah… I-I’m actually not sure why we don’t…
translation: 是啊……我、我其实不确定为什么不允许……

source: *sigh* How could you forget, Yoshinori?
translation: *叹气* 你怎么会忘记，Yoshinori？

source: Here at Camp Buddy, we encourage practical and survival skills not only for the sake of tradition, but also for the spirit of the camp itself.
translation: 在 Camp Buddy，我们鼓励实用技能和生存技能，不只是为了传统，也是为了营地本身的精神。

source: We try to encourage survival skills.
translation: 我们努力鼓励学习生存技能。

source: Yes, but for a reason.
translation: 是的，但这是有原因的。

source: We try to encourage practical and survival skills in the more traditional way as much as possible.
translation: 我们会尽可能以更传统的方式鼓励学习实用技能和生存技能。

source: That’s right. If the scouts are allowed to rely on technology, they’d be less focused on the lessons we’re trying to teach them.
translation: 没错。如果允许童军依赖科技，他们就会较少关注我们试图教授的课程。

source: This could actually put them in more danger because they lack the knowledge needed to adapt in any given situation.
translation: 这反而可能让他们更加危险，因为他们缺少适应各种情况所需的知识。

source: It would defeat the spirit of the camp.
translation: 这会违背营地精神。

source: Yes, we want to set a good example for our scouts.
translation: 是的，我们希望为童军树立好榜样。

source: More so, we believe it would go against the spirit of the camp, especially the social aspect of it.
translation: 更重要的是，我们认为这会违背营地精神，尤其是其中强调社交的部分。

source: Definitely. We encourage our campers to engage with one another on a personal level.
translation: 当然。我们鼓励营员在个人层面上彼此交流。

source: They enrolled here to experience and enjoy activities that they wouldn’t get to normally, where technology is often present.
translation: 他们报名来到这里，是为了体验和享受平时在科技环绕的环境中接触不到的活动。

source: Hmm… I understand that it’s due to the nature of this camp… But for the sake of emergencies, productivity, and marketing, we really need to consider integrating technology, at least on the administrative end.
translation: 嗯……我理解这是由营地性质决定的……但为了应对紧急情况、提高效率和进行宣传，我们确实需要考虑引入科技，至少行政管理方面应该如此。

source: For example, installing security cameras and putting a hub here in the office will allow the staff to maintain safety, reducing the need for daily patrols.
translation: 例如，安装安防摄像头并在办公室设置监控中心，就能让员工保障安全，减少每天巡逻的需要。

source: Yeah… And that would give me more time to do other important tasks…
translation: 是啊……这样我就会有更多时间处理其他重要任务……

source: We’ve been so stuck in our ways that we didn’t even consider all of this before…
translation: 我们一直太过墨守成规，以前甚至没考虑过这些……

source: I understand, sir. People are usually afraid of change because it’s something they’re not familiar with and are worried to impair what already works.
translation: 我理解，先生。人们通常害怕改变，因为改变意味着陌生事物，也担心破坏目前运转良好的东西。

source: But I assure you, with my services, we’ll be able to integrate new things without having to compromise on the true spirit of your camp!
translation: 但我向您保证，有我的服务，我们可以引入新事物，同时不损害贵营地真正的精神！

source: Excellent. I see now why Mr. Clermont chose you for this job.
translation: 很好。现在我明白Clermont先生为什么选择你完成这项工作了。

source: Anyway, I believe we’ve covered everything for this introductory meeting. Welcome to the team, Jin!
translation: 总之，我想这场介绍会议需要讨论的都已经谈完了。欢迎加入团队，Jin！

source: It’s my pleasure, sir! Thank you for having me…!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，先生！谢谢您接纳我……！

source: Now, if you don’t mind, I’ll be heading out for a while. Yoshinori, please assist Jin here with whatever he needs for today.
translation: 现在，如果你们不介意，我要暂时出去一趟。Yoshinori，今天 Jin 有任何需要，都请你协助。

source: Should we get you moved into our cabin now, Jin? Or get you some breakfast first, at least?
translation: Jin，现在先帮你搬进我们的木屋好吗？或者至少先吃点早餐？

source: Ah, I would like to work right away, if that’s okay. Thanks for the offer though.
translation: 啊，如果可以的话，我想立刻开始工作。不过还是谢谢你的好意。

source: No problem. Is there anything I can help you with now?
translation: 没问题。现在有什么我能帮忙的吗？

source: It’s the other way around, actually! I’ve been told that you don’t have a stay-in computer technician here at camp.
translation: 其实正好相反！我听说营地里没有常驻的计算机技术员。

source: So, I would like to teach you how to work with the computer and troubleshoot it in case no one is around to fix it.
translation: 所以我想教你如何使用计算机和排查故障，以防没有人能来维修。

source: That makes sense! To be honest, the most I’ve ever done with the computer is turn it on to read e-mails…
translation: 有道理！说实话，我对计算机做过最复杂的操作，也只是开机阅读电子邮件……

source: Oof… We’re gonna have to take the whole day to get you all caught up…
translation: 哦呜……看来得花一整天才能让你补齐这些知识……

source: Ah… I apologize. I’m probably going to be a lot to deal with when it comes to using computers – I barely know how the old one here works.
translation: 啊……抱歉。说到使用计算机，我可能会非常难教——连这里的旧电脑该怎么用都几乎不知道。

source: Well, we’re not going to use that PC anymore. I think using it would cause more headaches instead.
translation: 这个嘛，我们不会再使用那台电脑了。我觉得用它反而会制造更多麻烦。

source: In its current state, it won’t even scratch off a portion of our scope. It would be much faster and cheaper to build a new one.
translation: 以它目前的状态，连工作范围的一小部分都无法满足。组装一台新的会更快、更便宜。

source: Luckily, I came prepared! I assumed the worst and that the camp didn’t have a working PC, so I have a pre-built one for you guys in one of my suitcases here!
translation: 幸好我有备而来！我按照最坏情况假设营地没有能用的电脑，所以行李箱里带了一台为你们预先配好的主机！

source: Oh… So that’s what you’ve been carrying…
translation: 哦……原来你一直带着的是这个……

source: Yup! It will take me a little while to assemble this new one though.
translation: 没错！不过组装这台新电脑还需要一点时间。

source: You can assist me, and I’ll show you what each part does and how everything works!
translation: 你可以来协助我，我会向你展示每个部件的作用，以及整个系统如何运作！

source: Sure! Feel free to order me around to do whatever you like! I’m your personal slave for the day!
translation: 当然！想让我做什么尽管吩咐！今天我就是你的私人奴隶！

source: A-Ahh… The way you say it sounds like…
translation: 啊、啊……你这样说听起来好像……

source: A-Anyway, let’s get started…!
translation: 总、总之，开始吧……！

source: Okay… This new PC is all set up! It just needs to finish installing all of the software and programs, then it should be good to go!
translation: 好了……新电脑已经设置完毕！只要等所有软件和程序安装完成，就可以使用了！

source: That’s awesome! After helping you, I’ve started to understand a little better how everything works!
translation: 太棒了！帮你做完这些以后，我开始更加理解各个部分是如何运作的！

source: Thank you for taking so much time to teach me. The way you explained everything to me step by step made me realize how simple it actually was.
translation: 谢谢你花这么多时间教我。你一步一步解释所有内容，让我发现其实很简单。

source: I do feel bad that it took us all afternoon though… You probably could’ve finished a lot faster if it weren’t for me.
translation: 不过我们花了整个下午，确实让我有点过意不去……如果不是为了教我，你大概早就完成了。

source: Oh, it’s not a problem! It was actually fun teaching someone the stuff I do!
translation: 哦，没关系！把自己会的东西教给别人，其实很有趣！

source: Besides, the internet here is super slow, so it’s taking a long time to download everything anyway—
translation: 况且这里的网速特别慢，下载所有东西本来就需要很久——

source: A-Ah, sorry about that…! I forgot to have breakfast before I showed up today, haha!
translation: 啊、啊，抱歉……！今天过来以前忘记吃早餐了，哈哈！

source: Oh no! And we worked all the way through lunch too! You must be starving!
translation: 糟了！而且我们连午餐时间都一直在工作！你一定饿坏了！

source: It’s okay…! I’m used to skipping meals anyway! I tend to work on a very weird schedule…
translation: 没关系……！反正我已经习惯不吃饭了！我的工作时间通常很不规律……

source: Whenever I realize I’m hungry, I just go to the nearest convenience store and grab something there.
translation: 每当意识到自己饿了，我就去最近的便利店随便买点东西。

source: Oh, you don’t have to do that here! Our chef prepares three meals a day for everyone at camp!
translation: 哦，在这里不用那样！我们的厨师每天为营地里的所有人准备三餐！

source: We should really get you something to eat. Let’s head to the mess hall – dinner should be about ready!
translation: 真的该让你吃点东西了。我们去食堂吧——晚餐应该快准备好了！

source: Wh-Whoa…! This place is so crowded!
translation: 哇、哇……！这里好拥挤！

source: Ah, yes! The mess hall is usually full during mealtimes. It’s a bit more packed than usual since the workers for the project moved in yesterday!
translation: 啊，是的！用餐时间食堂通常都会坐满。因为项目工人昨天入住了，今天比平时更加拥挤！

source: You guys have quite the crowd here, huh? And most of them are… buff… guys…?
translation: 这里人真不少，对吧？而且大部分都是……身材强壮的……男人……？

source: Oh, haha! Most of them are construction workers, so they do tend to be more fit.
translation: 哦，哈哈！他们大多是施工人员，所以身体通常更健壮。

source: I… see.
translation: 我……明白了。

source: I hope you’re not intimidated by them, everyone here is very friendly!
translation: 希望他们没有吓到你，这里的每个人都很友善！

source: Order up! Two steak slabs coming right up!
translation: 上菜！两大块牛排马上来！

source: Over here, Aiden!
translation: 这边，Aiden！

source: I put some of my creamy special sauce on it, since you liked it so much yesterday~
translation: 你昨天那么喜欢，所以我在上面浇了些自己的奶油特制酱汁～

source: Yeah, it’s so good covering your meat, I can never get enough of it.
translation: 是啊，盖在你的肉上太美味了，我怎么吃都不够。

source: Stuff me up.
translation: 把我塞满。

source: Make sure to savor the taste when you swallow, alright~?
translation: 吞下去的时候一定要细细品味，好吗～？

source: WAH! Wh-What’s going on here?! Where am I exactly?!
translation: 哇！这、这里怎么回事？！我到底来到了什么地方？！

source: Huh? What’s the matter, Jin?
translation: 咦？怎么了，Jin？

source: I-Is no one else seeing what I’m seeing…?!
translation: 难、难道没有别人看见我看到的东西吗……？！

source: Oh… That’s actually one of our scoutmasters… He’s in charge of food service and camp maintenance.
translation: 哦……其实他是我们的童军团长之一……负责餐饮服务和营地维护。

source: And about his attire… I forgot to tell you ahead of time, but he has this habit of wearing “less” to cool down from all his work…
translation: 至于他的穿着……我忘了提前告诉你，他习惯少穿一点，好在工作后让身体降温……

source: As strange as it sounds, it’s actually quite normal around here…
translation: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但在这里其实相当正常……

source: THIS IS NORMAL HERE?!
translation: 这在这里算正常？！

source: Oh~ Hey, Yoshi!
translation: 哦～嗨，Yoshi！

source: Aiden, how many times have we talked about this…? You knew there were new people coming today…
translation: Aiden，我们谈过多少次这件事了……？你明知道今天会有新人来……

source: You could’ve at least put something on so you don’t catch our guests off guard.
translation: 你至少可以穿点东西，免得让客人措手不及。

source: Hey!! I am wearing something! See?! I’m wearing undies underneath right now!
translation: 喂！！我有穿东西！看见了吗？！我现在下面穿着内裤！

source: WAHHH!! BULGE!!!
translation: 哇啊啊！！鼓起来了！！！

source: Aiden! Put your apron down!
translation: Aiden！把围裙放下来！

source: Oho~ Is this the new guy? He’s quite the twink!
translation: 哦嚯～这就是新人吗？真是个纤细小受！

source: Hngh! T-Twink?!
translation: 嗯啊！小、小受？！

source: This is Jin, he’s our new technology specialist. I was going to bring him here earlier, but we had to get to work first!
translation: 这是 Jin，我们的新技术专家。我本来想早点带他过来，但我们得先开始工作！

source: H-Hello… Mr.… Uhh—
translation: 你、你好……先生……呃——

source: —Aiden! Nice to meet you, Jin!
translation: ——Aiden！很高兴认识你，Jin！

source: You look like you could use a meal or two! You’ve come to the right place!
translation: 瞧你这模样，正该好好吃上一两顿！你可来对地方了！

source: A-Aiden!!
translation: 艾、Aiden！！

source: Haha! I’m just kidding, Jin! I just love teasing newcomers like you!
translation: 哈哈！开个玩笑而已，Jin！我就是喜欢逗你这样的新人！

source: Something tells me that you and I are gonna have a good time here at camp~!
translation: 我的直觉告诉我，你和我会在营地里度过一段非常“愉快”的时光～！

source: A-Ahehe… I’m sure we… *gulp* definitely will…
translation: 啊、啊哈哈……我相信我们……*咽口水* 肯定会的……

source: *ehem* I apologize, Jin. Aiden is a very friendly person, and he can often be quite… physical as well.
translation: *咳咳* 抱歉，Jin。Aiden是个非常热情的人，而且经常会有些……肢体上的亲近。

source: I-It’s fine… I’m sure I can get used to it…
translation: 没、没关系……我想我会习惯的……

source: Haha! I like this guy! He knows how to “ride” along ~
translation: 哈哈！我喜欢这家伙！他很懂得怎么“骑”着配合～

source: *sigh* Aiden, can we just get something to eat? Jin hasn’t had a meal yet today.
translation: *叹气* Aiden，我们能先吃点东西吗？Jin 今天还没吃过饭。

source: Oh, right on time! I just finished serving everyone else, so we can have dinner together!
translation: 哦，来得正好！我刚给其他人上完餐，所以我们可以一起吃晚饭！

source: It’s the perfect chance for me to get to know Jin more… intimately.
translation: 这正是让我更……深入地了解 Jin 的绝佳机会。

source: Finally! It’s about time we had an official tech guy around here!
translation: 终于！我们这里早就该有一位正式的技术人员了！

source: I’m the closest they’ve got since I know a thing or two about electrical work. But boy, let me tell you, it’s not the same at all, not one bit!
translation: 以前最接近技术人员的就是我，因为我多少懂点电工活。但老兄，听我说，这跟专业技术完全不是一回事，一点都不是！

source: O-Oh…! I thought you were just the chef here?
translation: 哦、哦……！我还以为你只是这里的厨师？

source: Well, I am! I’m also the laundryman, gardener, pool-boy, or any kind of “job” you want me to do – I’m at your service!
translation: 没错，我是！我还是洗衣工、园丁、泳池小弟，或者任何你想让我干的“活”——随时为你服务！

source: You’re pretty “well rounded”, I see…
translation: 看来你还真是相当“面面俱到”啊……

source: Not in front of our salad, Aiden…!
translation: 别在我们的新人面前开黄腔，Aiden……！

source: *sigh* I’m so sorry about him, Jin.
translation: *叹气* 真对不起，Jin，他就是这样。

source: I-It’s not a big deal though…!
translation: 不、不过也没什么大不了的……！

source: I-I’d much prefer that you guys are comfortable with yourselves around me!
translation: 我、我倒更希望你们在我身边时能自在地做自己！

source: It’s just… my imagination has been running wild since I arrived here for some reason…
translation: 只是……不知为什么，自从来到这里，我的想象力就彻底失控了……

source: See, Yoshi? Jin’s cool with it!
translation: 看吧，Yoshi？Jin 完全不介意！

source: M-More like hot actually…
translation: 其、其实更像是热得受不了……

source: *ehem* But as Aiden was saying, feel free to approach him if you need something as well.
translation: *咳咳* 不过就像Aiden说的，如果你有什么需要，也尽管去找他。

source: Okay…!
translation: 好的……！

source: There’s one thing I wanted to ask though… How come only one person does all the chores?
translation: 不过我有件事想问……为什么所有杂务都只由一个人来做？

source: There’s one thing I wanted to ask though… How come only one person does all the chores?{fast}
translation: 不过我有件事想问……为什么所有杂务都只由一个人来做？{fast}

source: It's what he likes doing.
translation: 这是他喜欢做的事。

source: I’m sure Aiden doesn’t mind them! It’s what he likes doing after all!
translation: 我相信Aiden不会介意！毕竟这正是他喜欢做的事！

source: Yeah. I, uhh… guess you could say that.
translation: 是啊。我，呃……你也可以这么说。

source: We're looking to hire more people to help.
translation: 我们正打算再雇些人来帮忙。

source: We actually used to have more staff a couple years ago to do these tasks.
translation: 其实几年前我们还有更多员工负责这些工作。

source: Thankfully, we’re planning to hire more people to help, starting next term.
translation: 好在我们计划从下个营期开始，再雇一些人来帮忙。

source: Either way, I really don’t mind doing them. It’s what keeps these muscles alive after all!
translation: 不管怎样，我真的不介意做这些。毕竟正是这些活让我的肌肉保持活力！

source: I wish I could've helped him more.
translation: 我希望自己能多帮帮他。

source: Yeah, I know how difficult it must’ve been for Aiden to solo the past couple years. I wish I could’ve helped him more.
translation: 是啊，我知道过去几年让Aiden一个人扛下来有多辛苦。我真希望自己能多帮帮他。

source: Oh, come on, Yoshi! We both know you’ve been busy with your own tasks during the term. Besides, you’ve really been helping me with chores this off-season!
translation: 哦，得了吧，Yoshi！我们都知道营期里你有自己的工作要忙。更何况这次休营期你已经帮我做了很多杂务！

source: We wouldn't have made it this far without him.
translation: 没有他，我们不可能坚持到现在。

source: Aiden is really skilled at anything he does! We honestly wouldn’t have made it this far without him.
translation: Aiden做什么都很拿手！说真的，没有他，我们不可能坚持到现在。

source: Oh, shucks, Yoshi. You’re flattering me too much in front of Jin, hahaha!
translation: 哎呀，Yoshi。你当着 Jin 的面把我夸得太过头了，哈哈哈！

source: But really, it never fails to amaze me just how much work you do around here compared to the rest of us.
translation: 不过说真的，和我们其他人相比，你在这里承担的工作量总是让我惊讶。

source: I do have to admit, when I saw in the job briefing that there are only four full-time employees here at the camp, I wondered how you all managed to keep everything running…
translation: 我得承认，看到职位说明里写着营地只有四名全职员工时，我还在想你们究竟是怎么维持一切运转的……

source: Especially during the summer term when you have so many scouts around…
translation: 尤其是夏季营期，还有那么多童子军在这里……

source: A-Ah, that’s actually what I’m in charge of! I usually engage the campers with activities and make sure their time here at camp is memorable and meaningful.
translation: 啊、啊，那其实就是我负责的工作！我通常会组织营员参加活动，确保他们在营地度过一段难忘而有意义的时光。

source: It must’ve been nice that you guys had a little bit of a break before this project began then, huh?
translation: 那么在这个项目开始前，你们能稍微休息一阵，感觉一定不错吧？

source: Haha, not exactly – poor Yoshi here’s been losing his mind without stuff to keep him busy!
translation: 哈哈，也不完全是——可怜的Yoshi一闲下来，没事可忙都快憋疯了！

source: Before the workers arrived, there wasn’t much to do, even when I helped you with the chores.
translation: 工人们到来之前没多少事情可做，就算我帮你做杂务也是如此。

source: It’s different from the work that I’m used to, but I’m just glad to be useful again.
translation: 这和我习惯的工作不一样，但能再次派上用场，我就很高兴了。

source: Ah, I see...
translation: 啊，原来如此……

source: Hah, I knew I picked up a different scent today! The smell of coffee and old clothes is coming from that K-drama guy over there!
translation: 哈，我就知道今天闻到了不一样的气味！那边那个韩剧男身上散发着咖啡和旧衣服的味道！

source: Seriously? How do you even keep track of everyone’s scent here?!
translation: 不是吧？你到底是怎么记住这里每个人气味的？！

source: Hey, Sheriff Brokeback! Who is this guy?
translation: 喂，Sheriff Brokeback！这家伙是谁？

source: Yoichi, I thought you were over calling me that nickname!
translation: Yoichi，我还以为你已经不再用那个外号叫我了！

source: Jin, this is Yoichi and Taiga. They’re scouts here, but they stayed on as full-time volunteers.
translation: Jin，这两位是Yoichi和Taiga。他们是这里的童子军，不过留下来做了全职志愿者。

source: Oh, I see! Hello, nice to meet you guys! I’m Jin! I was sent here to work on tech upgrades for the camp!
translation: 哦，原来如此！你们好，很高兴认识你们！我是 Jin！我被派来负责营地的技术升级！

source: Great. Another nerd who looks like he doesn’t have friends, —
translation: 太好了。又来一个一看就没朋友的书呆子——

source: Ack!
translation: 啊！

source: —never goes out of his house, and only lives off instant noodles.
translation: ——从来不出门，只靠方便面过活。

source: Yoichi! Where are your manners?!
translation: Yoichi！你的礼貌呢？！

source: Wow, he read you to filth, huh…?
translation: 哇，他还真把你损得体无完肤啊……？

source: Eugh! Since when did you start talking like Spaghetti-boy?!
translation: 呃啊！你从什么时候开始学意面小子那样说话了？！

source: *sigh* I’m so sorry about Yoichi’s behavior, Jin. He’s rather hostile when it comes to meeting strangers…
translation: *叹气* Jin，Yoichi的行为真的很抱歉。他遇到陌生人时总是相当不友好……

source: He annoys everyone else here too, but you’ll get used to him.
translation: 他也会惹恼这里的其他所有人，不过你会习惯他的。

source: Shut up, Dynamite!
translation: 闭嘴，Dynamite！

source: H-He’s not wrong though...
translation: 不、不过他说得也没错……

source: I am kind of a shut-in, so I don’t often get the chance to make new friends, even online.
translation: 我算是个家里蹲，所以很少有机会结交新朋友，就连在网上也一样。

source: That’s why I’m really thankful of Mr. Clermont for putting me in a job where I have to be outdoors and around plenty of people to work with.
translation: 所以我真的很感谢Clermont先生，让我做一份必须待在户外、和许多人一起工作的差事。

source: I really needed a change in scenery, and to stop coding all alone in a dark room.
translation: 我确实需要换个环境，不能再独自窝在黑暗的房间里写代码了。

source: Though I’m surprised he was able to pick all that up from just my smell…
translation: 不过他居然只凭我的气味就看出了这些，实在让我惊讶……

source: Yeah, he’s part dog, so don’t be too surprised if he pees in your room to mark his territory.
translation: 是啊，他有一半是狗，所以哪天他跑到你房间撒尿标记领地，你也别太惊讶。

source: HEY!
translation: 喂！

source: *ehem* Please give Jin some space to enjoy his meal properly, you two.
translation: *咳咳* 你们两个，请给 Jin 留点空间，让他好好吃饭。

source: Speaking of which, how come Gayvid and Goliath get steak for dinner while the rest of us get fish and grass?!
translation: 说到这个，凭什么“基维德”和“歌利亚”晚餐能吃牛排，我们其他人却只能吃鱼和草？！

source: Is he talking about Lloyd and Darius…?
translation: 他说的是Lloyd和Darius……？

source: Shorty was fuming, so I had to drag him away before the giant finished him.
translation: 小不点气得直冒烟，所以我只好在那个巨人收拾掉他之前把他拖走。

source: Nah, Darius wouldn’t hurt a fly!
translation: 不会的，Darius连一只苍蝇都舍不得伤害！

source: Hah! He may be twice as huge, but I can still put up a fight! Wait till he sees how I take his meat!!
translation: 哈！他块头就算是我的两倍，我也照样能和他打一场！等着瞧我怎么抢走他的肉吧！！

source: …Okay. I give up.
translation: ……好吧。我放弃。

source: Anyway, Yoichi. If you’re still hungry, you’re welcome to join us.
translation: 总之，Yoichi。如果你还饿，欢迎和我们一起吃。

source: Two salmon fillets and Caesar salads coming right up!
translation: 两份三文鱼排和凯撒沙拉，马上就来！

source: BLECH!
translation: 呕！

source: {i}After our dinner, Jin and I went back to the office to finish up the computer setup.{/i}
translation: {i}晚饭后，我和 Jin 回到办公室，完成了电脑的设置。{/i}

source: There we go! Everything’s installed and ready to go!
translation: 好了！一切都安装完毕，可以用了！

source: Wow, it’s so different from our old PC… and it runs so fast too!
translation: 哇，和我们的旧电脑完全不一样……运行速度也好快！

source: It’ll run faster once we get your internet here upgraded! But that’s work for another day!
translation: 等这里的网络升级后，它还会运行得更快！不过那是改天的工作了！

source: O-Oh! Sorry! I thought there was nobody in here!
translation: 哦、哦！抱歉！我还以为这里没人！

source: Oh my! Who’s this fine gentleman?
translation: 哎呀！这位英俊的先生是谁？

source: Ah, I believe you two haven’t met yet! This is Jin! He’s the tech specialist that we were expecting today!
translation: 啊，我想你们还没见过面！这位是 Jin！他就是我们今天一直在等的技术专家！

source: Jin, this is Yuri, one of my fellow scoutmasters. She is also Sir Goro’s daughter.
translation: Jin，这位是Yuri，也是和我共事的童子军教官之一。她还是Goro先生的女儿。

source: I’m sorry I couldn’t meet you a little earlier, Jin! The workers kept me busy all day long today!
translation: 抱歉没能早点来见你，Jin！今天那些工人让我忙了一整天！

source: I hope you’ve found Camp Buddy welcoming at least!
translation: 希望伙伴营至少让你感受到了热情的欢迎！

source: What’s with all the stuff you’re carrying?
translation: 你抱着的这些东西是怎么回事？

source: Oh, these? It’s just some stuff I unboxed from some of my crates when I finished work today.
translation: 哦，这些吗？只是我今天做完工作后，从几个箱子里拆出来的一些东西。

source: A-Aaa…
translation: 啊、啊啊……

source: E-Eh…?
I-I’m s-sorry… but… that book you’re holding…
translation: 对、对不起……可是……你手里拿的那本书……

source: Is that… the limited edition… rare… unavailable-on-the-market…
translation: 难道那就是……限量版的……稀有的……市面上已经绝版的……

source: …“HOMERUN!” DOUJINSHI?!
translation: ……《※HOMERUN!§》同人志？！

source: *GASP*
translation: *倒吸一口气*

source: H-How did you know?!
translation: 你、你怎么知道？！

source: I… played the game that comic is based on… and I’m a big, no… HUGE fan!
translation: 我……玩过那本漫画改编自的游戏……而且我是它的忠实粉丝，不……是超级粉丝！

source: *gasp* Are you…? C-Could it be?!
translation: *吸气* 你也是……？难、难道说？！

source: Uhh… What’s going on…?
translation: 呃……发生什么事了……？

source: Y-You like BL too?!
translation: 你、你也喜欢 BL？！

source: Yes!!! I LOVE IT!!
translation: 是的！！！我超爱！！

source: OMG, I CAN’T BELIEVE I FOUND ANOTHER ONE LIKE ME!!!
translation: 天啊，我不敢相信我找到了另一个同好！！！

source: H-How did you get your hands on that?! It’s been phased out for years!
translation: 你、你是怎么弄到它的？！它已经绝版好几年了！

source: I know, right?! It took me so long to get this copy! But the yaoi gods blessed me when I saw on a forum that a store was selling one signed copy!
translation: 可不是吗？！我花了好久才拿到这一本！不过耽美之神眷顾了我，我在论坛上看到有家店在卖唯一一本签名版！

source: Yoshinori was even kind enough to buy it at the capital for me!
translation: Yoshinori甚至还好心地替我去首都把它买了回来！

source: This is the only one I was missing from my collection at home! I already have everything from this artist circle except for this!
translation: 这是我家里收藏中唯一缺少的一本！这个创作社团的作品，除了它以外我全都有了！

source: I pledged to myself that if I found someone selling it, I’d definitely buy it – no matter how high the price!
translation: 我早就发誓，只要发现有人出售，无论价格多高——我都一定会买下来！

source: But… I’m very up to date on all the forums! How could I have missed this sale?!
translation: 可是……所有论坛的消息我都追得很紧！我怎么可能错过这次出售？！

source: Hehe! Well, you’re looking at the number one bidder in BL black market!
translation: 嘿嘿！站在你面前的，可是 BL 黑市的头号竞标者！

source: WAIT! DON’T TELL ME… YOU’RE PINKBUTTERFLY69?!
translation: 等等！别告诉我……你就是 PINKBUTTERFLY69？！

source: Hihi~ That’s right~
translation: 嘻嘻～没错～

source: I can’t believe it! You’re a legend! I’ve read all your fanfics! I love them so much!
translation: 真不敢相信！你可是传奇人物！你的同人小说我全都读过！我太喜欢了！

source: OMG! I can’t believe you’ve read them! How embarrassing!
translation: 天啊！真不敢相信你居然读过！太让人害羞了！

source: What’s your favorite genre?
translation: 你最喜欢什么类型？

source: W-Well, I like them all, but I prefer… *ehem* muscles the most!
translation: 这、这个嘛，我全都喜欢，不过我最偏爱……*咳咳* 肌肉！

source: Kyaaa! Who doesn’t like muscles, right?!
translation: 呀啊啊！谁会不喜欢肌肉呢，对吧？！

source: I really can’t believe that I’m talking to THE pinkbutterfly69… and I’m looking at the long-lost “HomeRun!” doujinshi…
translation: 我真的不敢相信自己正在和那位 pinkbutterfly69 说话……而且眼前就是失传已久的《※HomeRun!§》同人志……

source: Well, you can borrow it if you want~
translation: 这个嘛，如果你想看，可以借给你哦～

source: You’d let me?! Really?! Awww!! Thank you so much!! You’re a goddess from heaven!
translation: 你愿意借给我？！真的吗？！啊啊啊！！太谢谢你了！！你简直是从天而降的女神！

source: Kyaaaaaaaa!!!! I’d love that so, so much!! It’s a deal!
translation: 呀啊啊啊啊啊！！！！我太、太想要了！！一言为定！

source: Err…
Y-You’re really into this stuff too… Jin?
translation: 你、你也真的很喜欢这些东西吗……Jin？

source: A-Ahh… S-Sorry… I lost my composure… I’m just overwhelmed!
translation: 啊、啊……对、对不起……我失态了……我只是太激动了！

source: Haha! It’s quite alright, I’m used to Yuri having moments like this all the time!
translation: 哈哈！完全没关系，Yuri经常这样，我早就习惯了！

source: I’m actually surprised you two resonate so much!
translation: 不过你们两个居然这么合拍，确实让我很惊讶！

source: Hehe! Of course, Yoshi, us BL lovers gotta stick together!
translation: 嘿嘿！当然啦，Yoshi，我们 BL 爱好者就是要团结在一起！

source: I was wondering why you were acting a little odd while I was touring you around today. I guess this explains a lot.
translation: 今天带你参观时，我还在想你为什么表现得有点奇怪。看来这就能解释很多事了。

source: I’m sorry… I tried to hide it since it was inappropriate behavior…
translation: 对不起……我觉得这种表现不太得体，所以一直想藏起来……

source: But everyone I met kept saying suggestive things left and right… I wasn’t sure if everyone knew my dirty little secret…
translation: 可我遇到的每个人都不停说些暧昧的话……我还以为大家都知道我这个羞耻的小秘密……

source: Oh, don’t think like that, Jin! We encourage everyone’s hobbies and interests here at Camp Buddy! So please feel free to express yourself!
translation: 哦，别这么想，Jin！伙伴营鼓励每个人发展自己的爱好和兴趣！所以尽管自在地表达自己吧！

source: W-Well… I just don’t want to make anyone feel uncomfortable… I promised myself I’d do my best to keep everything professional at this job.
translation: 这、这个……我只是不想让任何人觉得不舒服……我答应过自己，在这份工作中会尽量保持专业。

source: Well, you’ve already worked hard, even on your first day! I think you deserve to loosen up a little!
translation: 可是你第一天就已经很努力了！我觉得你值得稍微“放松”一下！

source: *sigh* You did it again…
translation: *叹气* 你又来了……

source: H-Huh??
translation: 什、什么？？

source: Anywaaay, what did you boys work on today?
translation: 总——之，你们两个今天做了些什么？

source: Ah! Jin replaced our office computer with a much better one! He even taught me how to use and troubleshoot it!
translation: 啊！Jin 给办公室换了一台好得多的电脑！他甚至还教会了我怎么使用和排除故障！

source: Oh yeah, I noticed it as soon as I got in here! It looks really cool, Jin! Thank you!
translation: 对哦，我一进来就注意到了！看起来真棒，Jin！谢谢你！

source: Y-You’re welcome.
translation: 不、不客气。

source: I’m actually shocked you were able to teach Yoshi about computers too. He’s such a caveman when it comes to anything tech. Must’ve taken the whole day, am I right?
translation: 你居然还能教会Yoshi电脑知识，我真的很震惊。他面对任何科技产品都像个原始人。一定花了整整一天，对吧？

source: Come on, you don’t have to rub it in my face, Yuri.
translation: 拜托，你没必要这样往我伤口上撒盐吧，Yuri。

source: Oh, and I noticed we have a new printer too?
translation: 哦，我还注意到我们也有新打印机了？

source: Yeah. It’s ten times more ink-efficient than the old one. I recommended this one when I found that you guys print out a lot of pamphlets and ad materials.
translation: 是的。它的墨水利用率是旧打印机的十倍。我发现你们会打印大量宣传册和广告材料后，就推荐了这一款。

source: I-It also has a scanner too, Yuri…! Mr. Clermont wanted to make sure you guys have all the basic office equipment.
translation: 它、它还有扫描功能，Yuri……！Clermont先生希望确保你们拥有所有基本办公设备。

source: O-Once you make soft copies of your collection, please share them with me too…
translation: 等、等你把收藏都做成电子版后，也请分享给我……

source: OMG! That gives me an idea, Jin! I could get a physical copy of all your stuff too! You’ll let me print them out, right?!
translation: 天啊！这倒提醒我了，Jin！我也可以把你的所有收藏做成实体版！你会让我打印出来的，对吧？！

source: *sigh* Try not to go overboard, Yuri…
translation: *叹气* 尽量别做得太过火，Yuri……

source: Hmph, killjoy! Young Yoshi would’ve said yes!
translation: 哼，扫兴鬼！年轻时的Yoshi肯定会答应！

source: Huh? You guys grew up together??
translation: 咦？你们是一起长大的？？

source: O-Oh… Sort of! Yuri, Aiden, Lloyd, Darius and I were actually from the very first batch of Camp Buddy scouts. Sir Goro was even our scoutmaster back then!
translation: 哦、哦……算是吧！Yuri、Aiden、Lloyd、Darius和我，其实都是伙伴营的第一批童子军。那时候Goro先生还是我们的教官！

source: Whoa! That’s big news to me…!
translation: 哇！这对我来说可是个大新闻……！

source: Haha, we’re just as surprised! Even though we took different paths after that first term, we ended up being reunited like this – and for the future of the camp too!
translation: 哈哈，我们也同样惊讶！虽然第一期结束后大家走上了不同道路，最后却又为了营地的未来像这样重聚了！

source: That’s really interesting… It makes me want to know more about this camp’s history…
translation: 这真有意思……让我更想了解这座营地的历史了……

source: Look no more! I have the perfect thing right here!
translation: 不用再找了！我这里正好有最合适的东西！

source: D-Do you really carry that around all the time, Yuri…?
translation: 尤、Yuri，你真的一直随身带着那个吗……？

source: Yup! This journal has all my precious scout memories! And they’re mostly about Camp Buddy’s debut!
translation: 没错！这本日记里全是我珍贵的童子军回忆！而且大多都和伙伴营刚成立时有关！

source: That’s really cool! I would love to read through it and learn the history of the camp.
translation: 这太棒了！我很想通读一遍，了解营地的历史。

source: I think understanding the camp’s origins would really help me with my work here.
translation: 我觉得了解营地的起源，会对我在这里的工作很有帮助。

source: Ah! That actually gives me an idea!
translation: 啊！这倒让我有了个主意！

source: Why don’t we work together to transcribe the journal and its pictures online? We could set up a section on the website Jin will be making called “The History of Camp Buddy”!
translation: 我们何不一起把日记和照片整理后放到网上？可以在 Jin 要制作的网站上开设一个名为《※伙伴营的历史§》的专栏！

source: That’s a great idea, Yoshi! But… so many of the pictures have deteriorated over the years, I’m not sure if they’ll really be useful.
translation: 好主意，Yoshi！可是……这么多年过去，很多照片都已经损坏了，我不确定它们还能不能派上用场。

source: Oh, but I bet Jin can fix those! He’s got so many computer skills, surely that’s one of them too!
translation: 哦，但我敢说 Jin 能修复它们！他会那么多电脑技术，这肯定也是其中之一！

source: *sigh* That’s not exactly the same as programming, Yoshi…
translation: *叹气* 那和编程并不是一回事，Yoshi……

source: Haha, actually, I know a thing or two about multimedia editing too! In fact, I used to do photo restoration as a side job before.
translation: 哈哈，其实我也懂一些多媒体编辑！事实上，我以前还兼职做过照片修复。

source: Wow! You can really do that?!
translation: 哇！你真的会做这个？！

source: Yeah, I’d love to! I’ll be honest, I’m very intrigued about all these photos you have!
translation: 是的，我很乐意！老实说，我对你拥有的这些照片非常感兴趣！

source: I know this is just my first day, but, for some reason, you guys make me feel like I’ve been a part of this for a long time!
translation: 我知道今天只是第一天，但不知为什么，你们让我觉得自己仿佛早已是这里的一员！

source: Awwww, Jin! You’re such a softboi! We must protect you at all costs!!!
translation: 啊啊啊，Jin！你真是个软萌男孩！我们必须不惜一切代价保护你！！！

source: I say we give it a shot right away! You guys can help me fix up the photos correctly based on your memory, and then we’ll transcribe the events from that day!
translation: 我觉得我们马上就可以试试！你们可以凭记忆帮我正确修复照片，然后我们再把当天发生的事情整理成文字！

source: Sounds like a plan!
translation: 就这么办！

source: The staff is ready for the scouts inside. The meal for the reception party is all prepared as well, sir!
translation: 工作人员已经在里面准备好迎接童子军了。欢迎会的餐点也全都备妥了，先生！

source: Thank you, Andre. You can return to your post now.
translation: 谢谢你，Andre。你现在可以回到岗位上了。

source: My daughter and I will wait here to welcome the scouts!
translation: 我和女儿会在这里等候，欢迎童子军们！

source: Alright, dear! Everything should be ready now for our first official day of Camp Buddy!
translation: 好了，亲爱的！伙伴营正式开营的第一天，一切应该都准备妥当了！

source: Wah… I can’t believe it’s actually happening, Dad! I’m so excited for all the activities and to make new friends!
translation: 哇……真不敢相信这一天真的来了，爸爸！一想到那些活动和即将认识的新朋友，我就好兴奋！

source: I’m excited as well.  I’m sure we’ll have a memorable first term considering how much we’ve prepared for this!
translation: 我也很兴奋。我们为此准备了这么久，我相信第一期一定会令人难忘！

source: I can help you teach everyone, Dad! I’ve learned a lot from our camping days together, after all!
translation: 我可以帮你教大家，爸爸！毕竟我们以前一起露营时，我已经学到了很多！

source: Well, you can leave all the work to me, dear! I’m a scoutmaster now, and your job as a scout is to have fun and learn as much as you can!
translation: 好了，工作都交给我吧，亲爱的！我现在是童子军教官，而你作为童子军的任务，就是尽情享受并尽可能多地学习！

source: Fine! But you better not bore everyone with your lectures!
translation: 好吧！不过你最好别用长篇大论把大家都说困了！

source: Haha, I promise we’ll have all sorts of activities to suit everyone’s interests!
translation: 哈哈，我保证会准备各种各样的活动，满足每个人的兴趣！

source: Oh, oh! Look, Dad! Someone just got here!
translation: 哦，哦！快看，爸爸！有人刚到了！

source: Come on, let’s greet our first scout!
translation: 走吧，我们去迎接第一位童子军！

source: Hello! Welcome to Camp Buddy!
translation: 你好！欢迎来到伙伴营！

source: Good morning, sir! I’m Yoshinori Nagira! I registered here for the summer!
translation: 早上好，先生！我是Yoshinori Nagira！我报名参加了这里的夏令营！

source: My name is Goro Nomoru! I’m the camp president, and I’ll be your scoutmaster for this term!
translation: 我叫Goro Nomoru！我是营地负责人，也是你本期的童子军教官！

source: It’s nice to meet you, Sir Goro! Thank you for having me!
translation: 很高兴认识您，Goro先生！谢谢您接纳我！

source: Looks like you’re quite the early bird, Yoshinori! The assembly is still an hour from now!
translation: 看来你来得真早，Yoshinori！距离集合还有一个小时呢！

source: Phew… I thought I was late when I saw there was already a scout here, haha…!
translation: 呼……看到这里已经有一位童子军时，我还以为自己迟到了，哈哈……！

source: Quite the contrary, you’re the first one to arrive! And this scout beside me is my daughter!
translation: 正好相反，你是第一个到的！而我身边的这位童子军是我的女儿！

source: Hi, Yoshinori~! I’m Yuri! Nice to meet you!
translation: 你好，Yoshinori～！我是Yuri！很高兴认识你！

source: It’s nice to meet you too, Yuri! You can call me Yoshi!
translation: 我也很高兴认识你，Yuri！你可以叫我Yoshi！

source: We’re gonna have so much fun this summer, Yoshi! There’s plenty of others coming soon, and there’ll be at least a hundred of us!
translation: 这个夏天我们一定会玩得非常开心，Yoshi！很快还会有很多人来，至少会有一百人！

source: Wah, that’s exciting! I read from the brochure we’re also gonna learn a lot, too!
translation: 哇，太令人期待了！我在宣传册上看到，我们也会学到很多东西！

source: That’s right! Camp Buddy is a scout-themed summer camp, after all!
translation: 没错！毕竟伙伴营是一座以童子军为主题的夏令营！

source: We’re taking the survival, teamwork and leadership skills from scouting and mixing them up with all the fun, recreational activities of a summer camp!
translation: 我们把童子军活动中的生存、团队合作和领导能力，与夏令营里各种有趣的娱乐活动结合在一起！

source: That’s exactly what I signed up for, sir!
translation: 这正是我报名参加的原因，先生！

source: I never got the chance to join something like this when I was little, so I’m really looking forward to experiencing it now!
translation: 我小时候从来没有机会参加这样的活动，所以现在真的很期待亲身体验！

source: Now that’s the spirit! I really appreciate your enthusiasm!
translation: 这才是应有的精神！我非常欣赏你的热情！

source: Kyaaaa! We should get you in your uniform already, Yoshi~!
translation: 呀啊啊！我们该赶快让你换上制服了，Yoshi～！

source: Let’s get you dressed! I have the perfect tie color for you!
translation: 来给你换衣服吧！我有一种最适合你的领带颜色！

source: Looks like we’re in for a great year!
translation: 看来我们会迎来精彩的一年！

source: We’ve got you settled in at last, Jin… Today’s been such a long day!
translation: 总算把你安顿好了，Jin……今天真是漫长的一天！

source: You said it! I can’t remember the last time I was this active!
translation: 可不是嘛！我都记不得上次这么活跃是什么时候了！

source: I was so nervous that I’d screw up dealing with so many new people. But you really made me feel warm and welcome from the get-go!
translation: 要和这么多陌生人打交道，我本来紧张得生怕搞砸。但从一开始，你就让我感受到了温暖和欢迎！

source: Thank you so much for being such a great host, Yoshinori!
translation: Yoshinori，真的很谢谢你这么热情地接待我！

source: It’s my pleasure, Jin! That really means a lot coming from you!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，Jin！能听你这么说，对我意义重大！

source: Now please get some rest, you can take the top bunk on the right side!
translation: 现在请好好休息吧，你可以睡右边的上铺！

source: Oh, right! You did say earlier we’d be sharing the room with others. Where are they?
translation: 哦，对了！你之前确实说过我们还要和其他人共用房间。他们在哪里？

source: I gotta tell you, Aiden, you’re such a Gemini! Very adaptable, a multitasker, and quite the charmer!
translation: 我得告诉你，Aiden，你真是个典型的双子座！适应力强、能同时处理多项事务，而且特别有魅力！

source: *sigh* You must be popular with everyone! Life is so unfair! Why am I such an Aries?!
translation: *叹气* 你一定很受大家欢迎！人生太不公平了！为什么我偏偏是白羊座？！

source: Where do you even learn all these things, Lloyd?
translation: Lloyd，你到底是从哪里学到这些东西的？

source: From fiction.
translation: 从虚构作品里。

source: Horoscopes are not fiction! How do you explain why everything is so accurate, huh?!
translation: 星座可不是虚构的！不然你怎么解释每一条都这么准，嗯？！

source: Good evening, you guys!
translation: 晚上好，各位！

source: Whoa! Don’t tell me Jin’s our roommate too?!
translation: 哇！别告诉我 Jin 也是我们的室友？！

source: Yeah! He’ll be taking the last bunk in here!
translation: 没错！他会睡这里最后一张空床！

source: The more, the merrier, right?
translation: 人越多越热闹，对吧？

source: I-I did notice that there are only four beds, so I can sleep on the couch…!
translation: 我、我确实注意到这里只有四张床，所以我可以睡沙发……！

source: Oh, I’m not letting you do that, Jin! You can use mine!
translation: 哦，我可不会让你睡沙发，Jin！你可以睡我的床！

source: Oh, come on, you guys! No one’s sleeping on the couch. Dar and I can just share one bed!
translation: 哦，拜托，各位！谁都不用睡沙发。我和Dar挤一张床就行！

source: A-Are you sure…?
translation: 你、你确定吗……？

source: Haha, it feels like we’re all in a big sleepover or something, am I right?
translation: 哈哈，感觉我们像是在举办一场大型过夜派对，对吧？

source: Well, I’m not sleeping just yet! I still have to brew up my nightly detox!
translation: 好了，我还不打算睡！我还得冲泡每晚的排毒饮料！

source: A-Actually, I need to make some coffee too.
translation: 其、其实，我也得泡点咖啡。

source: Coffee? This late at night?
translation: 咖啡？这么晚了还喝？

source: Yeah… I have some stuff I wanted to work on still.
translation: 是啊……我还有些事情想继续做。

source: Sheesh, Yoshi. Look what you’ve done to Jin in just a day.
translation: 天啊，Yoshi。看看你才一天就把 Jin 变成什么样了。

source: A-Ah, n-no, Aiden. It’s really just a habit of mine…
translation: 啊、啊，不、不是的，Aiden。这真的只是我的习惯……

source: Just don’t stay up too late, alright, Jin?
translation: 只要别熬得太晚就好，明白吗，Jin？

source: S-Sure…
translation: 好、好的……

source: Good night. I’m going to sleep.
translation: 晚安。我要睡了。

source: I’m hitting the hay too! Got another long day coming up tomorrow!
translation: 我也要上床睡觉了！明天又会是漫长的一天！

source: Good night, guys!
translation: 晚安，各位！

source: {i}Sharing the cabin with everyone made me feel like I was a scout again.{/i}
translation: {i}和大家共住一间小屋，让我觉得自己仿佛又成了童子军。{/i}

source: {i}It’s only been a few days, and so much has changed already!{/i}
translation: {i}才过去短短几天，就已经发生了这么多变化！{/i}
